label_mapping: seeded permutation of task-to-hypothesis IDs; logical task zero is dominant when requested
event_order: seeded permutation of task IDs, fixed within episode; source 0 then source 1; interleaved loops rounds then tasks then sources; task_blocked loops tasks then rounds then sources
reference: one unmodified engine per explicit task; same task input subsequence with original timestamps; total workspace capacity and engine overhead are unmatched; diagnostic isolation control, not superiority baseline
raw_contract: one JSONL episode per exact Cartesian cell, containing cell/config, all input records, ignition records, final workspace and coalition state, work counters and per-task metrics
stopping_rule: execute frozen Cartesian grid once, replicate bytes under two PYTHONHASHSEED values, report all cells; implementation failure stops interpretation; any changed experimental choice requires a new protocol
claims: bounded implementation diagnostic only; no formal identity, promotion, default-world performance, v03/v032/v05/M1 inference, biological, novelty or energy claim
controls: single task, capacity-only intervention, zero global margin, task isolation, balanced/dominant strength, arrival order and seeded relabeling
protocol_mutation: reject any value, type, field or order that differs from this committed protocol
